ACS 2016-2020 CONUS female population by state

Source: R/urps_state_alloc.R
urps_state_female_pop.Rd

Returns a data frame of contiguous-US female population by state derived from ACS 2016-2020 5-year estimates, Table B01001_026. Rows are sorted by state FIPS code.

Usage

urps_state_female_pop()

Source

U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2016-2020 5-Year Estimates, Table B01001_026 (total female), contiguous U.S. (48 states + DC). https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT5Y2020.B01001

Value

A data.frame with 49 rows and four columns:

state_abbr

Character. Two-letter USPS state abbreviation.

state_fips

Character. Two-digit Census FIPS code, zero-padded.

female_pop

Integer. ACS 2016-2020 5-year female population count.

female_share

Double. State share of CONUS female population (sums to 1).

Carries attribute source = "ACS 2016-2020 5-year, Table B01001_026, CONUS female population.".

See also

Other urps geography: urps_allocate_national(), urps_state_alloc_weights(), urps_state_entrant_shares()

Examples

df <- urps_state_female_pop()
nrow(df) # 49
#> [1] 49
sum(df$female_pop) # 164690617
#> [1] 164690617
head(df)
#>   state_abbr state_fips female_pop female_share
#> 1         AL         01    2481661  0.015068624
#> 2         AZ         04    3682671  0.022361146
#> 3         AR         05    1503453  0.009128954
#> 4         CA         06   19433752  0.118001574
#> 5         CO         08    2856726  0.017346016
#> 6         CT         09    1813099  0.011009121
